detail:
Decisions: Chose to extend the existing plugin-tool-references test to assert surface classification in README.md and docs/TWINING-REFERENCE.md, parsing only table rows so prose mentioning a tool does not trip it, rather than fixing the tables by hand alone — the inversion had persisted through many releases precisely because nothing checked it, and it immediately caught two entries (twining_status, twining_archive) I had missed in a Lifecycle subsection; Chose to state the Gate 1 / Gate 2 enforcement asymmetry explicitly in the README rather than keep the simpler 'hooks enforce both automatically' — that claim was false for Gate 1 (instruction-only), and the field measurement of 90.7% voluntary compliance is a more useful and more honest thing to tell a prospective user than an enforcement promise the code does not make; Chose to document twining_record as the default-surface substitute for twining_decide/link_commit/override rather than recommend enabling full_surface — full_surface exists to keep the tool list small, and steering users to flip it to reach a tool they already effectively have would defeat that
Findings: Confirmed the high-severity doc-inversion finding against the real registration: docs/TWINING-REFERENCE.md listed 7 full-surface-only tools (dismiss, decide, search_decisions, reconsider, link_commit, verify, handoff) in its 'always registered' table and omitted all 7 default graph/status/archive tools from it, while its Extended section listed 9 tools that are actually default. README's Core table listed 6 of the 13 default tools and put 7 default tools under 'requires full_surface'.; The new surface test caught real drift on its first run beyond what I had fixed by hand — twining_status and twining_archive remained in TWINING-REFERENCE's Lifecycle subsection. Hand-auditing tables does not scale; the assertion does.; README now carries a 'Using It Well' section grounded in field measurements rather than intuition: decisions are permanent while the blackboard archives on a rolling horizon of days, pass commit_hash (12% linkage measured), pass agent_id (91% collapsed to 'main' despite 39 names in use), use narrow scopes, and write real rationale.
summary: Fixed the inverted tool-surface tables in README and TWINING-REFERENCE (confirmed high-severity finding) and added field-derived usage guidance
